test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I sent the agreement over for them to sign so __the ball is now in their court.__

options.text: An approach that uses traditional ideas that have previously worked
Better to be satisfied with what you have than risk losing it by trying to get something better
A time when after which programmes for older audiences may be aired on TV
It is time for someone to deal with a problem or make a decision, because other people have already done as much as they can

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"the ball is now in their court"** means that it is time for someone else to take action or make a decision because others have already done as much as they can. (अब बारी उनकी है)

 
 
• **Example: **We have made our final offer, and now** the ball is in their cour**t.
 
 
 
• **"It is time for someone to deal with a problem or make a decision, because other people have already done as much as they can"** indicates a shift in responsibility to another party. (अब निर्णय लेने का समय उनका है क्योंकि दूसरे लोग जितना कर सकते थे कर चुके हैं)
 
 
• **Example: **After months of negotiations, the proposal is complete, and now **the ball is in the management's court.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **An approach that uses traditional ideas that have previously worked** (ऐसा तरीका जो पहले काम कर चुका है):

 
 
• **Example: **She prefers an approach that uses traditional ideas that have previously worked in similar situations.
 
 
 
• **Better to be satisfied with what you have than risk losing it by trying to get something better** (जो है उससे संतुष्ट रहना बेहतर है बजाय इसके कि कुछ बेहतर पाने के लिए उसे खोने का जोखिम उठाया जाए):
 
 
• **Example: **He believes it's better to be satisfied with what you have than risk losing it by trying to get something better.
 
 
 
• **A time when after which programmes for older audiences may be aired on TV** (वह समय जिसके बाद टीवी पर वयस्क दर्शकों के लिए कार्यक्रम प्रसारित किए जा सकते हैं):
 
 
• **Example: **The watershed is the time when after which programmes for older audiences may be aired on TV.
 
 

5a:Tc10,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
